comment: Britain daily life. Every location here is a nav id from Data/Custom/navigation.json - there are no coordinates in this file, including the clock anchor. A shopkeeper entry is identified by its SPAWNER, not its vendor type, so two of the same trade can have different homes. Adding a seventh shopkeeper needs no code: place a home destination with [NavMark and [NavArrival, add a vendor subclass if the trade is not already covered, and add one line here.
